# Data dictionary

Every column the pipeline accepts, where it comes from, and how it is classified. The classification drives de-identification: every document path built from a `direct_identifier` column must be transformed by the demo policy, and a test enforces it.

| classification | columns | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| direct_identifier | 17 | identifies a person on its own (name, record number, full dates, contact details) |
| quasi_identifier | 8 | identifies in combination (sex, race and ethnicity, language, ZIP3, year of birth) |
| clinical | 16 | health information |
| operational | 16 | identifiers of records and places, statuses |
| reference | 2 | codes from public code systems |

## roster - Patient roster and attribution

Full snapshot of every patient attributed to the network: identity, demographics, contact details, attributed clinic, primary care provider, care manager and problem list. Each delivery replaces the previous one; the warehouse keeps history as slowly changing dimension (type 2).

- **Steward:** Patient registration data steward
- **Supplier:** EHR registration extract
- **Delivery:** every 7 days, grace 0 day(s); full snapshot, history kept (type 2)
- **Natural key:** patient_id
- **Accepted date formats:** `%Y-%m-%d`, `%m/%d/%Y` (detected per file)
- **Publishes:** published.patients, published.patient_conditions, published.patient_attribution_history

### Supplier layouts

| source | file name | layout | change record | source column -> canonical |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ehr_roster | `^roster_(?P<extract>[0-9]{8})(?:_r(?P<redelivery>[0-9]+))?\.csv$` | v1 |  | MRN -> patient_id, FIRST_NAME -> first_name, LAST_NAME -> last_name, DOB -> birth_date, SEX -> sex, RACE -> race, ETHNICITY -> ethnicity, PREF_LANGUAGE -> language, ADDRESS1 -> address_line1, CITY -> city, ZIP -> zip, PHONE -> phone, EMAIL -> email, PAYER_TYPE -> payer_type, SITE_CODE -> site_id, PCP -> pcp_name, CARE_MANAGER -> care_manager_name, PROBLEM_LIST -> problem_list, REG_DATE -> registration_date |

### Columns

| column | type | classification | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `patient_id` | VARCHAR | direct_identifier | Medical record number, eight digits with leading zeros. |
| `first_name` | VARCHAR | direct_identifier | Given name. |
| `last_name` | VARCHAR | direct_identifier | Family name. |
| `birth_date` | DATE | direct_identifier | Date of birth (a full date is an identifier; the year alone is a quasi-identifier). |
| `sex` | VARCHAR | quasi_identifier | Administrative sex: F, M, X or U. |
| `race` | VARCHAR | quasi_identifier | Race as recorded at registration. |
| `ethnicity` | VARCHAR | quasi_identifier | Ethnicity as recorded at registration. |
| `race_ethnicity` | VARCHAR | quasi_identifier | Single reporting category; Hispanic or Latino takes precedence, blanks become Unknown. |
| `language` | VARCHAR | quasi_identifier | Preferred language code. |
| `language_group` | VARCHAR | quasi_identifier | English, Spanish, Other or Unknown. |
| `address_line1` | VARCHAR | direct_identifier | Street address. |
| `city` | VARCHAR | quasi_identifier | City. |
| `zip` | VARCHAR | direct_identifier | Five-digit ZIP code (the first three digits are a quasi-identifier). |
| `phone` | VARCHAR | direct_identifier | Ten digits, punctuation removed; blank when it cannot be standardised. |
| `email` | VARCHAR | direct_identifier | E-mail address. |
| `payer_type` | VARCHAR | quasi_identifier | commercial, government, marketplace, self_pay or unknown. |
| `site_id` | VARCHAR | operational | Attributed clinic. |
| `pcp_name` | VARCHAR | operational | Primary care provider (workforce, not patient data; replaced in demo copies by policy). |
| `care_manager_name` | VARCHAR | operational | Assigned care manager (workforce). |
| `problem_list` | VARCHAR | clinical | Semicolon-separated ICD-10-CM codes. |
| `registration_date` | DATE | direct_identifier | Date the patient registered with the network. |

## screenings - Behavioral health and social needs screenings

One row per screening encounter from the screening platform, item-level and wide: nine PHQ-9 items, seven GAD-7 items, five social-needs domains and the platform's own totals. The warehouse reshapes it to one row per instrument (scored) and one row per item.

- **Steward:** Behavioral health data steward
- **Supplier:** Screening platform export
- **Delivery:** every 7 days, grace 0 day(s); incremental, merged by natural key
- **Natural key:** screening_id
- **Accepted date formats:** `%Y-%m-%d`, `%m/%d/%Y` (detected per file)
- **Publishes:** published.screening_events, published.screening_items

### Supplier layouts

| source | file name | layout | change record | source column -> canonical |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| screening_platform | `^screenings_(?P<extract>[0-9]{8})(?:_r(?P<redelivery>[0-9]+))?\.csv$` | v1 |  | screening_id -> screening_id, mrn -> patient_id, screen_date -> screen_date, admin_mode -> admin_mode, phq9_q1 -> phq9_q1, phq9_q2 -> phq9_q2, phq9_q3 -> phq9_q3, phq9_q4 -> phq9_q4, phq9_q5 -> phq9_q5, phq9_q6 -> phq9_q6, phq9_q7 -> phq9_q7, phq9_q8 -> phq9_q8, phq9_q9 -> phq9_q9, phq9_total -> phq9_total_reported, gad7_q1 -> gad7_q1, gad7_q2 -> gad7_q2, gad7_q3 -> gad7_q3, gad7_q4 -> gad7_q4, gad7_q5 -> gad7_q5, gad7_q6 -> gad7_q6, gad7_q7 -> gad7_q7, gad7_total -> gad7_total_reported, sdoh_housing -> sdoh_housing, sdoh_food -> sdoh_food, sdoh_transport -> sdoh_transport, sdoh_utilities -> sdoh_utilities, sdoh_safety -> sdoh_safety |

| `screening_id` | VARCHAR | operational | Platform identifier of the screening encounter. |
| `patient_id` | VARCHAR | direct_identifier | Medical record number. |
| `screen_date` | DATE | direct_identifier | Date administered (a full date tied to a patient is an identifier). |
| `admin_mode` | VARCHAR | operational | in_person, telehealth or portal. |
| `phq9_q1 .. phq9_q9` | INTEGER | clinical | PHQ-9 item responses, 0-3. |
| `phq9_total_reported` | INTEGER | clinical | Total as computed by the platform (checked |
| `gad7_q1 .. gad7_q7` | INTEGER | clinical | GAD-7 item responses, 0-3. |
| `gad7_total_reported` | INTEGER | clinical | Total as computed by the platform. |
| `sdoh_housing .. sdoh_safety` | VARCHAR | clinical | Social needs by domain: Y (need), N (no need), D (declined). |

## labs - Laboratory results

Results for the tracked analytes (HbA1c and LDL cholesterol) from the reference laboratory. The laboratory changed its file layout on the 2026-03-02 extract (change record CR-004): renamed columns, explicit units, a specimen identifier, and HbA1c reported in IFCC mmol/mol by part of its network. Both layouts map to one canonical table.

- **Steward:** Clinical data steward
- **Supplier:** Reference laboratory
- **Delivery:** every 7 days, grace 0 day(s); incremental, merged by natural key
- **Natural key:** lab_result_id
- **Accepted date formats:** `%Y-%m-%d`, `%m/%d/%Y` (detected per file)
- **Publishes:** published.lab_results

### Supplier layouts

| source | file name | layout | change record | source column -> canonical |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| reference_lab | `^labs_(?P<extract>[0-9]{8})(?:_r(?P<redelivery>[0-9]+))?\.csv$` | v1 |  | OrderID -> lab_result_id, MRN -> patient_id, Collected -> collected_date, LOINC -> loinc_code, TestName -> test_name, Result -> result, RefRange -> reference_range, AbnFlag -> abnormal_flag |
| reference_lab | `^labs_(?P<extract>[0-9]{8})(?:_r(?P<redelivery>[0-9]+))?\.csv$` | v2 | CR-004 | accession_id -> lab_result_id, patient_mrn -> patient_id, collection_date -> collected_date, loinc_code -> loinc_code, test_description -> test_name, result_value -> result, result_units -> units, reference_range -> reference_range, abnormal_flag -> abnormal_flag, specimen_id -> specimen_id |

### Columns

| column | type | classification | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lab_result_id` | VARCHAR | operational | Order or accession number of the result. |
| `patient_id` | VARCHAR | direct_identifier | Medical record number. |
| `collected_date` | DATE | direct_identifier | Specimen collection date. |
| `loinc_code` | VARCHAR | reference | LOINC code as sent. |
| `analyte` | VARCHAR | reference | Tracked analyte: HBA1C or LDL. |
| `result_raw` | VARCHAR | clinical | Result text exactly as sent. |
| `result_value` | DECIMAL(10,2) | clinical | Numeric result in the unit sent; censored results (<4.0) keep the bound. |
| `censor` | VARCHAR | clinical | '<' or '>' when the laboratory reported a bound rather than a value. |
| `units` | VARCHAR | clinical | Unit as sent (v2) or implied by the code (v1). |
| `value_std` | DECIMAL(10,1) | clinical | Result in the standard unit (HbA1c %, LDL mg/dL). |
| `specimen_id` | VARCHAR | operational | Specimen identifier (layout v2 only). |

## appointments - Appointments and visits

Appointments from two scheduling systems covering two populations - the clinics' EHR scheduling and the mobile unit - in different layouts, unioned into one table. Deliveries are incremental: new bookings plus status changes (a booked appointment later becomes completed, no-show or cancelled), merged by source and appointment number.

- **Steward:** Operations data steward
- **Supplier:** Clinic scheduling and mobile unit scheduling
- **Delivery:** every 7 days, grace 0 day(s); incremental, merged by natural key
- **Natural key:** source, appointment_id
- **Accepted date formats:** `%Y-%m-%d`, `%m/%d/%Y` (detected per file)
- **Publishes:** published.appointments

### Supplier layouts

| source | file name | layout | change record | source column -> canonical |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| clinic_scheduling | `^appointments_main_(?P<extract>[0-9]{8})(?:_r(?P<redelivery>[0-9]+))?\.csv$` | v1 |  | APPT_ID -> appointment_id, MRN -> patient_id, SITE -> site_id, APPT_DATE -> appt_date, VISIT_TYPE -> visit_type, STATUS -> status, PROVIDER -> provider_name |
| mobile_unit | `^appointments_mobile_(?P<extract>[0-9]{8})(?:_r(?P<redelivery>[0-9]+))?\.csv$` | v1 |  | visit_id -> appointment_id, mrn -> patient_id, host_site -> site_id, visit_date -> appt_date, visit_kind -> visit_type, visit_status -> status |

### Columns

| `provider_name` | VARCHAR | operational | Rendering provider (clinic scheduling only; workforce). |

## pharmacy - Pharmacy claims

Paid and reversed pharmacy claims for the tracked drug classes. A reversal arrives as a second row with the same claim number and status R, sometimes a week later; fills are netted before adherence is calculated. Claims adjudicate late, so rows for a closed measurement year keep arriving after it closes.

- **Steward:** Pharmacy data steward
- **Supplier:** Pharmacy benefit claims feed
- **Delivery:** every 7 days, grace 0 day(s); incremental, merged by natural key
- **Natural key:** claim_id, claim_status
- **Accepted date formats:** `%Y-%m-%d`, `%m/%d/%Y` (detected per file)
- **Publishes:** published.pharmacy_fills, published.pharmacy_claims

### Supplier layouts

| source | file name | layout | change record | source column -> canonical |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| pharmacy_claims | `^rx_claims_(?P<extract>[0-9]{8})(?:_r(?P<redelivery>[0-9]+))?\.csv$` | v1 |  | claim_id -> claim_id, member_mrn -> patient_id, fill_date -> fill_date, drug_name -> drug_name, strength -> strength, days_supply -> days_supply, quantity -> quantity, claim_status -> claim_status, adjudicated_date -> adjudicated_date |

### Columns

| column | type | classification | description |
